mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_product WHERE del_flag = '0' AND category_id = #{categoryId}

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.category_code, c.parent_id, c.description, c.sort, c.org_id, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_by, c.update_by, c.del_flag, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_product p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.del_flag = '0') AS product_count FROM iot_product_category c WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.category_code, c.parent_id, c.description, c.sort, c.org_id, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_by, c.update_by, c.del_flag, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_product p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.del_flag = '0') AS product_count FROM iot_product_category c JOIN category_tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id WHERE c.del_flag = '0') SELECT * FROM category_tree ORDER BY sort, id
